group_by.description: Columns to group by before scoring (e.g. site_id, region). Protected from dropping.
group_by.title: Group By

id_column.description: Row-identifier column to carry through to the output but exclude from features.
id_column.title: Id Column

ignore.description: Glob patterns of columns to ignore. Prefix with 'type:<polars_dtype>' to restrict the glob to columns of that dtype, e.g. 'type:String id_*'.
ignore.title: Ignore

include_only.description: When set, only these columns (plus protected ones) are considered. Useful for narrowing scope without touching the source schema.
include_only.title: Include Only

reference_column.description: Optional binary reference label (0/1) used only for evaluation, not training.
reference_column.title: Reference Column

time_column.description: Primary timestamp column. Protected from identifier-drop heuristics and used for temporal features and history alignment.
time_column.title: Time Column

DetectorConfig.description: Configuration for a single anomaly detector.

enabled.description: Skip this detector entirely when False.
enabled.title: Enabled

params.description: Detector-specific hyperparameters, forwarded verbatim to the wrapper constructor. Nest an 'extra_params' table to pass arbitrary kwargs straight to the underlying sklearn estimator, e.g. params = { n_estimators = 300, extra_params = { n_jobs = 4 } }. Keys are validated at construction; reserved keys (random_state, contamination) and keys already exposed as wrapper arguments are rejected.
params.title: Params

train_row_cap.description: Subsample the training data to at most this many rows before fitting this detector. Unset uses the detector's built-in cap (isolation_forest 250000, kmeans_distance 200000, one_class_svm 25000, lof 50000, ecod/hbos 500000). Set a value larger than your dataset to train on every row.
train_row_cap.title: Train Row Cap

DetectorConfig.title: DetectorConfig

enabled.description: Disable to skip the explanation stage entirely.
enabled.title: Enabled

kernel_shap.description: Fall back to KernelSHAP for models where TreeSHAP is unavailable. Much slower; sets a FallbackAttributionWarning.
kernel_shap.title: Kernel Shap

max_rows.description: Explain at most this many rows; rows beyond the cap are skipped.
max_rows.title: Max Rows

permutation_importance.description: Also compute permutation importance as a cross-check. Roughly doubles explanation runtime.
permutation_importance.title: Permutation Importance

top_n.description: Number of top contributing features to surface per anomalous row.
top_n.title: Top N

correlation_reduction.description: Drop one column from each pair with Pearson |r| >= correlation_threshold. Reduces redundancy for distance-based detectors.
correlation_reduction.title: Correlation Reduction

correlation_threshold.description: Correlation magnitude above which one of the pair is dropped.
correlation_threshold.title: Correlation Threshold

dtype.description: Output dtype of the feature matrix. float32 halves memory vs float64.
dtype.title: Dtype

max_feature_width.description: If the encoded feature matrix would exceed this many columns a FeatureWidthWarning is raised (or error in strict mode).
max_feature_width.title: Max Feature Width

missing_indicators.description: Emit '<col>__is_missing' boolean features for high-null columns.
missing_indicators.title: Missing Indicators

one_hot_max_cardinality.description: Categorical columns with n_unique <= this get one-hot encoding. Above this threshold frequency encoding is used instead.
one_hot_max_cardinality.title: One Hot Max Cardinality

pca.description: Compress features with PCA after scaling. Useful when the feature matrix is very wide; adds latency and reduces explainability.
pca.title: Pca

pca_max_components.description: Maximum number of PCA components to retain.
pca_max_components.title: Pca Max Components

pca_min_explained_variance.description: Stop adding PCA components once cumulative explained variance exceeds this.
pca_min_explained_variance.title: Pca Min Explained Variance

scaler.description: 'robust' uses median+IQR (less sensitive to extreme outliers). 'standard' uses mean+std (required if downstream models assume z-scores).
scaler.title: Scaler

time_derivatives.description: Temporal derivatives to extract from the chosen time column. Supported: hour, dayofweek, day, month, year, quarter.
time_derivatives.title: Time Derivatives

HistoryConfig.description: Controls baseline comparison and trend detection.

bootstrap_periods.description: Minimum periods of history required before history scoring activates.
bootstrap_periods.title: Bootstrap Periods

lookback_periods.description: Number of historical periods used to build the baseline.
lookback_periods.title: Lookback Periods

low_volume_threshold.description: The shortest rolling window is flagged low-volume (shown in the HTML report) when its current population is below this -- informational only; low-volume periods are still included in every aggregate.
low_volume_threshold.title: Low Volume Threshold

max_backfill_periods.description: Maximum periods to backfill when catch-up runs are requested.
max_backfill_periods.title: Max Backfill Periods

roll_non_business.description: Include weekends and holidays when computing rolling baselines.
roll_non_business.title: Roll Non Business

HistoryConfig.title: HistoryConfig

ProfilingConfig.description: Thresholds that control column classification during profiling.

categorical_cardinality_ratio.description: String columns with cardinality_ratio <= this are classified 'categorical'. Above this threshold they go through the identifier / free-text path.
categorical_cardinality_ratio.title: Categorical Cardinality Ratio

free_text_mean_length.description: String columns with mean value length > this (after failing other checks) are classified 'free_text' and dropped.
free_text_mean_length.title: Free Text Mean Length

identifier_cardinality_ratio.description: String columns with cardinality_ratio > this are candidates for identifier_like classification (subject to pattern checks).
identifier_cardinality_ratio.title: Identifier Cardinality Ratio

identifier_detection.description: 'conservative' only flags UUID/hex patterns at high cardinality. 'aggressive' also flags any high-cardinality string. 'off' never classifies as identifier_like (use when IDs carry signal).
identifier_detection.title: Identifier Detection

near_constant_distinct.description: A non-empty column with n_unique <= this is classified 'near_constant' and dropped (too low variance to be useful).
near_constant_distinct.title: Near Constant Distinct

null_ratio_drop.description: Columns with null_ratio > this are classified 'high_null' and dropped. A missing-indicator feature is still emitted when missing_indicators=True.
null_ratio_drop.title: Null Ratio Drop

null_ratio_flag.description: Columns with null_ratio > this (and <= null_ratio_drop) get a '<col>__is_missing' indicator feature appended. Default 0.0 means any column with at least one null emits an indicator.
null_ratio_flag.title: Null Ratio Flag

sample_rows_for_examples.description: Number of non-null rows sampled for example values and mean-length estimation.
sample_rows_for_examples.title: Sample Rows For Examples

ProfilingConfig.title: ProfilingConfig

ReportConfig.description: Output report settings. Excluded from the config hash (cosmetic only).

formats.description: Report formats to generate. Supported: html, csv, json.
formats.title: Formats

open_after.description: Open the HTML report in the default browser after generation.
open_after.title: Open After

rolling_windows.description: Rolling window sizes (in periods) shown in trend charts.
rolling_windows.title: Rolling Windows

ReportConfig.title: ReportConfig

RunConfig.description: Execution-level settings. workdir is required; everything else has a default.

log_level.description: Python logging level for the sorethumb logger. Logs are written to both the console and {workdir}/logs/sorethumb.log (rotating, 10 MB limit, 5 backups). Does not affect the config hash.
log_level.title: Log Level

max_memory_mb.description: Pre-flight cap on the projected feature-matrix size (rows x encoded columns x dtype bytes). A run whose estimate exceeds this aborts with MemoryBudgetError before any model is fitted. It is not a live RSS ceiling -- actual peak memory can still exceed the budget.
max_memory_mb.title: Max Memory Mb

max_rows.description: Truncate the input to at most this many rows (after filtering). Triggers SampleTruncatedWarning. None uses all rows.
max_rows.title: Max Rows

retention_days.description: Prune run artefacts older than this many days from workdir.
retention_days.title: Retention Days

reuse_models.description: If a matching model artefact exists in workdir, skip retraining. Useful for score-forward runs.
reuse_models.title: Reuse Models

seed.description: Global random seed for reproducible results.
seed.title: Seed

slow_stage_seconds.description: Emit a SlowStageWarning if any pipeline stage exceeds this many seconds. Purely diagnostic; does not affect results.
slow_stage_seconds.title: Slow Stage Seconds

strict.description: Promote all SorethumbWarnings to errors. Always active in the test suite.
strict.title: Strict

workdir.description: Workspace root directory where all run artefacts are stored.
workdir.title: Workdir

RunConfig.title: RunConfig

ScoringConfig.description: How per-detector scores are combined into a single anomaly score.

combination.description: 'composite' averages normalised detector scores and applies a single global threshold. 'intersection' thresholds each detector independently then flags rows where ALL detectors agree (high precision). 'union' thresholds each detector independently then flags rows where ANY detector agrees (high recall).
combination.title: Combination

contamination.description: Review-budget knob: the fraction of rows to flag. NOT an estimate of how many anomalies the data contains -- it sizes the shortlist you are willing to review. A float in (0, 0.5] makes each detector flag exactly that fraction and sets the OneClassSVM nu to match. 'auto' lets each detector use its own heuristic boundary (OCSVM zero-hyperplane, KMeans Tukey fence, IsolationForest offset); these rates differ per detector and the run output reports the realised rate of each.
contamination.title: Contamination

min_records.description: Minimum rows needed to run scoring. Fewer rows raise a CalibrationModeWarning (or error in strict mode).
min_records.title: Min Records

weighting.description: How detector weights are set for combination='composite' (ignored by 'intersection' / 'union'). 'equal': 1/n each. 'manual': from `weights`. 'agreement': by each detector's rank correlation (leave-one-out Spearman) with the consensus ranking; anti-correlated or flat detectors get weight 0.
weighting.title: Weighting

weights.description: Per-detector weights, used only when weighting='manual'.
weights.title: Weights

ScoringConfig.title: ScoringConfig

SourceConfig.description: Where the raw data lives and how to read it.

auth.description: HTTP authentication scheme. Token/credentials come from auth_env_var.
auth.title: Auth

auth_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the auth credential. For auth='bearer', the token value. For auth='basic', 'user:password' in plain text -- it is base64-encoded automatically to build the header; do not pre-encode it. Read at runtime and never stored in the config or logs.
auth_env_var.title: Auth Env Var

cache.description: Cache downloaded files locally. Disable only for tiny or always-fresh sources.
cache.title: Cache

dataset_id.description: Stable logical identity for this dataset, kept constant across snapshots (appended rows, corrections, the file moving to a new path). All history -- periods, per-group totals, runs -- is keyed on it. When unset it is derived from 'uri'; set it explicitly so a change of path does not orphan prior history. Allowed characters: letters, digits, '.', '_', '-' (max 128).
dataset_id.title: Dataset Id

format.description: File format. 'auto' infers from the file extension. Set explicitly when the extension is misleading.
format.title: Format

max_download_bytes.description: Reject an http(s) download whose declared (Content-Length) or actual streamed size exceeds this many bytes. Guards against an unbounded or misconfigured remote response.
max_download_bytes.title: Max Download Bytes

max_nesting_depth.description: Maximum recursion depth for struct unnesting. 0 disables unnesting.
max_nesting_depth.title: Max Nesting Depth

read_options.description: Format-specific reader overrides, e.g. {'delimiter': '|', 'null_values': ['NA']}. Passed verbatim to the polars scan_* call.
read_options.title: Read Options

uri.description: Local path or http(s) URL to the source file.
uri.title: Uri

SourceConfig.title: SourceConfig

description:
Top-level sorethumb configuration.

The library always receives a fully-resolved ``Config`` object.
Construct it programmatically in tests; use the CLI layer for TOML/env/flag
resolution in production.
title: Config
